description: This file defines the Subunit entity class for the OrangeHRM system, representing organizational subunits with hierarchical nesting support using Doctrine ORM and NestedSet pattern.

classes.name: Subunit
classes.description: An entity class representing a hierarchical organizational subunit with nested set properties, mapped to 'ohrm_subunit' table in the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the subunit.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the subunit.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the subunit.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the subunit.

methods.name: getUnitId
methods.description: Returns the unit ID associated with the subunit, if any.

methods.name: setUnitId
methods.description: Assigns a unit ID to the subunit.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the subunit.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description for the subunit.

methods.name: getLft
methods.description: Returns the left value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setLft
methods.description: Sets the left value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getRgt
methods.description: Returns the right value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setRgt
methods.description: Sets the right value in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: getLevel
methods.description: Returns the depth level of the subunit in the hierarchy.

methods.name: setLevel
methods.description: Sets the depth level of the subunit.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Returns the NodeInterface object representing this subunit in the nested set hierarchy.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Assigns a NodeInterface object to this subunit.
